invisibility-owner-belt-pace.head: 195819f4
invisibility-owner-belt-pace.scope: The stock Belt measured 395.2 and 450.1 units/s at rank 20 and rank 50 (ratio 1.139). Movement percentages were 0.10 and 0.25, then 0.22 and 0.37 when combined with Hyper-Speed. Turning Belt off restored normal Hyper-Speed at 0.45.

stats.source: Invisibility 175 grants 1116 and authors passive 878, whose AbilityAttributeLink points to percent-valued stat 1051.
stats.runtime: The learned total is 10 at rank 20 and 25 at rank 50.
stats.test: BeltConsumesTheLearnedOwnerPercentageAndUpdatesOnArchiveChange checks the shipped link and value type and isolates both ranks. PR1049 observed the corresponding movement percentages in the stock client. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1049#issuecomment-7120345490

consumer.source: The 878 link feeds queued movement speed while the 1116 Invisibility Belt is active.
consumer.runtime: AbilityBuffs projects the learned 1051 owner percentage in the Belt movement channel. AbilityPassives republishes it on Archive changes while the Belt is active.
consumer.test: PR1049 measures 395.2 to 450.1 units/s in the Belt pose, 442.7 and 492.2 with Hyper-Speed, and the normal 0.45 scale after ending the Belt. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1049#issuecomment-7120345490

behavior-tests.source: Shipped 175 grant membership and the 878 to 1051 link apply during the issued 1116 Belt ability.
behavior-tests.runtime: Loadout changes replace only the linked movement contribution while the Belt remains active. Ending Belt removes the contribution, and Speed stacks separately.
behavior-tests.test: BeltConsumesTheLearnedOwnerPercentageAndUpdatesOnArchiveChange verifies both ranks, removal/reload during the same Belt instance and return to baseline after ending. ShadowUpgradeUsesTheDirectInvisibleMovementChannelAndRestoresItWithoutChangingLifetime checks independent Shadow and Hyper-Speed stacking. The retained membership replay covers issued 1116. Stock PR1049 independently checks movement and cleanup. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1049#issuecomment-7120345490
